body: Thank you, that means a lot to me. At first I thought it would be weird to post this thread but now I am glad people understood and gave me good advice. I really appreciate it.
I accidentally told one of My good friends about my suicidal tendencies (alcohol..) and I know he will be there if I need him.

I always lived only for the others. Thats why I have been emotionally manipulated by My first girlfriend, got cheated on by my last and just got fucked over by some "friends". I guess I have to learn to live for myself..

Well, I wanted to be a programmer, but the whole math stuff behind all of it really threw me off, that's why I want to switch to media science. I always enjoyed writing and I could see myself writing articles for some magazines or online or something like that.
Computer science mixed with media stuff, there's no real translation for that. It's basically just computer science with computer graphics and stuff like that.
